notes: This map states what a user can observe. The expected totals live in verify_totals.py, because a document that recorded them would be a second place for a behaviour regression to edit.

features.behavior: A cart with nothing in it totals to zero rather than erroring or printing nothing.
setup: run the CLI with no amounts

features.behavior: A cart with one amount totals to that amount.
setup: run the CLI with a single positive amount

features.behavior: Amounts that are all negative total to a negative number, so a credit is not silently treated as a charge.
setup: run the CLI with only negative amounts

features.behavior: Amounts that cancel to nothing total to zero, which is the case an off-by-one in the accumulator gets wrong.
setup: run the CLI with two amounts that cancel

features.behavior: An amount that is not a whole number is handled deliberately rather than by whatever the interpreter does with it.
setup: run the CLI with a non-integer amount
coverage_gaps: no check exercises non-integer input; the CLI's behaviour there has not been decided and therefore has not been verified

features.behavior: An amount larger than a machine word totals without wrapping or losing precision.
setup: run the CLI with an amount beyond 64-bit range
coverage_gaps: no check exercises amounts beyond 64-bit range; Python integers do not wrap, so this is unverified rather than known-broken
